The '''Snaykinn Pass''' was a canyon located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was used as a racetrack for the [[Nashal River Race]], allowing pilot to reach the [[Jeassa River]] form the [[Mephyt River|Krisa River]].<ref name="SWG:NRT" />
